user.title: EV Stats
user.description: Only four entities are needed to start. Everything else â€” house load, solar, prices, tyres, carbon â€” is optional and is configured afterwards.

data_description.charging_power: The car's charging power in kW. Every energy figure here is integrated from this.
data_description.odometer: Total distance. Used for trips, consumption and the petrol comparison.
data_description.battery: Battery percentage. Used as a boundary between two charges, never as an energy meter.
data_description.home_zone: Used to recognise charging at home.

abort.already_configured: That car is already set up.

init.title: EV Stats options
init.description: Every field here is optional. Leaving one empty removes the sensors that depend on it rather than reporting a zero.

car.name: The car
car.description: Extra signals from the vehicle. Each one adds sensors; none is required.

data_description.engine_state: Used to detect trips. Far more reliable than speed, which reads zero at every set of lights.
data_description.device_tracker: Only trusted when the odometer has not moved since the fix was taken.
data_description.supply_source: An entity reading AC or DC. Only a DC session can be classed as public fast charging; without this signal that verdict is never reached, rather than being guessed from how fast the car is charging.

location.name: Location
location.description: Where charging counts as free, and how close is close enough.

data_description.work_zones: Zones where charging costs nothing â€” a workplace charger, for instance. Each becomes its own bucket.
data_description.record_positions: Off by default. With it on, each trip stores where it started and ended to the metre, which is what a route map needs - and what a shared dashboard would reveal about where you live.

house.name: The house
house.description: Without house load the integration cannot prove a charge happened here, and falls back to location alone.

data_description.export_price: Solar sent to the car is priced at the feed-in it gave up, not at zero.

data_description.ambient_temp: Recorded with each pack measurement. A cold pack charges less efficiently, and that seasonal swing can exceed the degradation being looked for.
data_description.notify_target: For example notify.mobile_app_pixel. Session summaries with correction buttons go here.

thresholds.name: Thresholds
thresholds.description: Defaults are measured values, not guesses. Change them only with evidence.

data_description.min_kwh: Below this the house-load test is noise, so it declines to answer rather than guessing.
data_description.charge_efficiency: Wall to pack. Cancels out of a degradation trend, so its exact value matters less than its consistency.
data_description.install_odometer: Set this to the odometer reading now. Consumption is measured from here, not from the car's whole life.

move_energy.name: Move energy between buckets
move_energy.description: Reattribute charging energy from one place to another. Refuses rather than clamping if the source bucket does not hold enough, so the buckets always sum to the metered total.

config_entry_id.name: Car
config_entry_id.description: Which EV Stats entry to act on.

source_bucket.name: From
source_bucket.description: The bucket the energy is currently in, for example unknown.

target_bucket.name: To
target_bucket.description: Where it should go instead, for example home.

kwh.name: Energy
kwh.description: How much to move, in kWh.

cost.name: Cost
cost.description: Optional. Left out, a fair share of the source bucket's cost moves with the energy.

solar_kwh.name: Solar
solar_kwh.description: Optional. Left out, a fair share of the source bucket's solar moves with the energy.

correct_session.name: Correct a session's attribution
correct_session.description: Refile a logged charging session somewhere else. Moves its energy, and restates what it cost - the same charge is free at a workplace and priced at home, so the figure is replaced rather than carried.

config_entry_id.name: Car
config_entry_id.description: Which EV Stats entry to act on.

session_id.name: Session
session_id.description: The id from the charge sessions log.

bucket.name: Attribute to
bucket.description: Where the session actually happened, for example home.

log_dc_session.name: Log what a public charge cost
log_dc_session.description: The energy from a public charger is already metered by the car. What it cost is billed at the pump and reaches nothing here, so this is the one figure that has to be typed in.

config_entry_id.name: Car
config_entry_id.description: Which EV Stats entry to act on.

cost.name: Cost
cost.description: What the charge was billed at.

session_id.name: Session
session_id.description: Optional. Attaches the cost to one logged session as well as the total.

import_legacy.name: Import logs from the YAML version
import_legacy.description: Read charge sessions, trips and pack measurements out of the template sensors of a YAML install. Safe to run twice: records already held are skipped. Imports the logs only, never the bucket balances, which would double-count.

config_entry_id.name: Car
config_entry_id.description: Which EV Stats entry to import into.
